description: A second `struct` declaring an already-declared type name raises `ol-duplicate-definition` at phase-1 registration, carrying BOTH spans: `source_span` at the later declaration (line 2) and `params.original_span` at the earlier one (line 1), so the message can name the line the learner already used (`spec/error-model.md:126,145-148`). Ruling #833 rule 6 gives redefining YOUR OWN name its own code, leaving `ol-reserved-word` with exactly one meaning. The field lists deliberately DIFFER (`[ x y ]` vs `[ a b ]`) so this fixture cannot pass under a rule that only notices two identical declarations. `check()` reports the identical code, params and spans for this program.
